nature: Development comparison decided after the Stage 2B, 2C, 2D and 3A results were seen. One CPU run. Not a confirmatory test, not an independent validation, not a final Test. The entry criteria below are operating criteria for spending budget, set on data already looked at; they are not significance or generalisation criteria.
question: With a fixed manipulation policy, can the decision to intervene be made from run-time observations alone so that task success increases while degradation of baseline-successful runs stays limited?

fixed.task: pinned StackCube-v1 / ManiSkill, existing runtime semantics
fixed.base_policy: D500-clean 80k EMA, existing weights and metadata hashes
fixed.policy_inference: observation / action / prediction horizon 2 / 8 / 16, DDPM 100 steps
fixed.data: common C0 / R5 records of Stage 2B and Stage 2D only

only_change: model input: all 568 saved policy_feature dimensions, standardised on the unique training snapshots of the fold, plus the checkpoint one-hot; no PCA

candidates.M_Q_full: 568 standardised policy_feature + checkpoint one-hot; two binary heads; score = q_R - q_C
candidates.M_pair_full: same input; multinomial over the four joint outcomes; score = p(Rescue) - p(Harm)

decision_rule: R5 if score > 0, otherwise Continue (a score of exactly 0 is Continue). 0 is the net-gain boundary, not a harm tolerance; no risk constraint is claimed.
forbidden: search over C / dimensions / threshold / penalty / seed
new RGB encoder or hand-made features
R2M / H0M / Refresh / new recovery actions

entry_criteria.evaluation: cached single-intervention reading on repeat 0, leave-one-scene-out
entry_criteria.1: in Stage 2B and in Stage 2D separately: successful scenes not fewer than Never and not fewer than the training-selected timer
entry_criteria.2: over both stages: at least 2 more successful scenes than Never and at least 2 more than the training-selected timer
entry_criteria.3: scenes turned from baseline success into failure: at most 1 over both stages
entry_criteria.4: net gain over Never of at least 1 scene in Stage 2B and in Stage 2D
entry_criteria.5: all folds and integrity checks complete, no scene missing, every fit converged

if_a_candidate_passes: the only next step is a real run of that one fixed candidate against Never and a fixed timer on 24 new development scenes (at most 72 full episodes), after a sample and cost report and a separate approval; nothing is rented automatically
